programme.title: Luck
programme.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.

programme.title: Bobby Jasoos
programme.desc: A rich man asks Bobby, a private detective, to find two girls and a boy in return for a huge sum. Although she accomplishes the assigned tasks, she struggles to understand the motive behind them.

programme.title: Khakee
programme.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.

programme.title: Zila Ghaziabad
programme.desc: A gang war erupts between corrupt chairman Brahampal and gangster Fauji. Betrayal and shifting loyalties escalate the conflict, plunging the village into chaos and violence as personal vendettas drive the characters towards an uncertain future.

programme.title: Aan: Men At Work
programme.desc: On a mission to make Mumbai crime-free, DCP Hari Om Patnaik and his team fights against some corrupt politicians and their associates. In the process, their faith in law and order is put to test.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Mihika, an investment banker, misses her flight to Delhi and meets Manu Gupta, a talkative man. In order to reach Delhi on time, she must tag along with Manu and put up with his antics.
